description: Development pro forma for a Canadian build: land + land transfer tax, hard costs, soft costs, HST net of the new-housing rebate, construction financing, contingency, sale proceeds, profit, margin and ROI.

drawSchedulePct.description: Average share of costs drawn during the build, percent

estimatedSalePrice.description: Expected sale price when finished in CAD

financingRatePct.description: Construction loan rate as a percent

grossFloorAreaSqft.description: Gross floor area in square feet

landPurchasePrice.description: Land price in CAD (0 if already owned, with ownsLand)

province.description: Province or territory of the project

sellingCommissionPct.description: Commission on the sale as a percent
